rv.q: The production, directed by Danya Taymor, is impressively original despite being lumpy in places and incoherent in others.

"The Outsiders," despite its considerable appeal, can't yet bear too much reality. Awkward, yearning, fast on its feet, the show, like the adolescents it describes, is still trying on various identities.
With a few tweaks, this musical could be Broadway-ready, and with its unique look and sound, it could carve its own path, both with fans of the book and newcomers to the story.
